ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering Tax Evasion Schemes
ideas.description: Investigate the methods used by individuals to evade taxes and underreport income, and explore the impact on the economy and social services.
questions: What are the most common methods used to evade taxes?
How do these schemes affect the economy and social services?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to expose widespread tax evasion and underreporting, highlighting the need for increased scrutiny and regulation. By analyzing data and conducting investigative reporting, we can shed light on the extent of the issue and its consequences.
